name: Exp_MBKAsctrend3
summary: This EA trades based on the MBKAsctrend3 custom indicator, which uses a weighted combination of three Williams Percent Range (WPR) indicators with different periods to generate buy and sell signals. It opens positions on signal bar crossovers and closes opposite positions when reversal signals appear, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MBKAsctrend3自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用三个不同周期的威廉指标(WPR)加权组合来生成买卖信号。在信号出现时开仓，在反转信号出现时平掉反向仓位，并支持可配置的资金管理和止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于三个不同周期(9/33/77)的WPR指标加权组合，通过权重(1.0/3.0/1.0)计算综合动量信号来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标上轨(UpValue)在指定信号柱上出现非零非空值时触发买入信号，当下轨(DnValue)出现时触发卖出信号。出场条件包括两种：一是反向信号出现时平仓（如持有空仓时出现上轨信号则平空），二是通过StopLoss和TakeProfit固定点数止损止盈。仓位管理采用MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。该EA还包含历史回溯逻辑，在未收到直接平仓信号时会向前搜索历史柱寻找最近的平仓信号，以确定是否需要平掉当前持仓。策略默认使用H4周期，属于中期动量跟踪类型。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on a weighted combination of three WPR indicators with different periods (9/33/77), calculating a composite momentum signal through weights (1.0/3.0/1.0) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator's upper buffer (UpValue) shows a non-zero, non-empty value on the specified signal bar; a sell signal triggers when the lower buffer (DnValue) shows such a value. Exit conditions include two types: first, closing opposite positions when a reversal signal appears (e.g., closing shorts when an upper signal emerges), and second, fixed-point stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. The EA also includes a historical lookback logic that searches backward through bars for the nearest closing signal when no direct close signal is received, determining whether existing positions should be liquidated. The strategy defaults to the H4 timeframe, classifying it as a medium-term momentum-following system.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，负值为固定手数，正值为存款比例
parameters.description_en: Trade share; negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit percentage

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Maximum price slippage deviation in points

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的柱索引

pros: 多周期WPR加权组合有效平滑了单一指标的噪音信号，提高了信号可靠性
支持灵活的资金管理方式（固定手数或存款比例），适应不同交易需求
具备完善的买卖和平仓权限控制，可以灵活配置只买、只卖或双向交易
使用IsNewBar机制避免同一根K线内重复交易，减少了过度交易风险
pros_en: The multi-period WPR weighted combination effectively smooths noise from a single indicator, improving signal reliability
Flexible money management supporting both fixed lot size and deposit-proportional sizing adapts to different trading needs
Comprehensive buy/sell/close permission controls allow flexible configuration for long-only, short-only, or bidirectional trading
The IsNewBar mechanism prevents duplicate trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
cons: 历史回溯平仓逻辑(第155-181行)遍历所有历史柱，在数据量大时可能导致严重性能问题
止损1000点止盈2000点的默认值过大，可能在很多品种上不合适
缺少点差过滤和波动率过滤，在高点差或低波动环境下可能产生不利交易
没有对指标句柄的有效性进行充分检查，OnInit失败时EA仍继续运行
cons_en: The historical lookback closing logic (lines 155-181) iterates through all historical bars, potentially causing severe performance issues with large datasets
Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large and may be unsuitable for many instruments
Lacks spread filter and volatility filter, which may produce unfavorable trades in high-spread or low-volatility environments
Insufficient validation of the indicator handle; the EA continues running even if OnInit fails to obtain it
improvements: 为历史回溯平仓逻辑添加最大回溯柱数限制，避免性能问题
增加点差过滤和ATR波动率过滤，避免在不利市场条件下开仓
在OnInit中指标句柄获取失败时返回INIT_FAILED而非继续运行
improvements_en: Add a maximum lookback bar limit to the historical closing logic to avoid performance degradation
Add spread filter and ATR volatility filter to prevent opening positions under unfavorable market conditions
Return INIT_FAILED in OnInit when the indicator handle cannot be obtained instead of continuing to run

risk_points: 指标句柄获取失败时EA不会停止运行，可能在无信号的情况下持续执行交易逻辑
历史回溯遍历无上限，极端情况下可能遍历数万根K线导致交易线程阻塞
没有点差检查，在流动性差的市场中滑点可能远超预期
risk_points_en: The EA does not stop running when the indicator handle fails to initialize, potentially executing trading logic without valid signals
The unlimited historical lookback iteration could traverse tens of thousands of bars in extreme cases, blocking the trading thread
No spread check means slippage in illiquid markets could far exceed expectations
